question.question: Do equally ranked systematic reviews agree on whether Serenoa repens improves lower urinary tract symptoms due to benign prostatic enlargement?

records.source_title: Saw palmetto extracts for treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia: a systematic review
records.target_indication: lower urinary tract symptoms due to benign prostatic enlargement
records.notes: The 1998 systematic review reported evidence suggesting Serenoa repens improves urologic symptoms and urinary flow measures in symptomatic BPH.
